question: Is there a spending ceiling on the company card for one-off vendors?
reference_answer: The Navan Purchasing Card is for ad hoc vendors and purchases under $5,000 USD annually; anything above that must go through Zip procurement.

question: Do I have to keep receipts for small card purchases in the US?
reference_answer: US team members need receipts only for purchases over $50; receipts must be uploaded into Navan within 30 days of the transaction.

question: Can I just buy a Figma-type subscription for myself and get my money back?
reference_answer: No. Software purchases charged to personal or corporate cards are denied for reimbursement; you must follow the individual use software process, and annual spend per person should not exceed $5,000.

question: My friend of a friend wants to join us, do I get a bonus if I put in a good word?
reference_answer: No. Bonuses are granted only to referrals, not endorsements. Someone you cannot speak about confidently is an endorsement, not a referral.

question: How many free therapy visits does the mental health benefit cover per year?
reference_answer: Modern Health provides 6 complimentary therapy sessions per year, plus 6 coaching sessions.

question: Can my kids use the counselling perk too?
reference_answer: Yes. Eligible family members include a spouse or partner, children up to age 27 and a partner's children up to age 27.

question: What time does my system access get cut off when I leave the company?
reference_answer: Access is deactivated on your last day at 4pm local time, Monday to Friday.

question: How long can the trial period at the start of a job be, and does it restart if I move countries?
reference_answer: Some team members have a probation period of 1 to 9 months depending on location. With uninterrupted service, someone who passed probation does not repeat it after relocating or changing contract.

question: Are brainteaser questions okay when several of us interview a candidate together?
reference_answer: No. Panel interviews should have no difficult or trick questions; they are conversations, not tests.

question: Am I expected to answer work messages in the evening or while on holiday in Ireland?
reference_answer: No. Team members are expected to disconnect from work and work-related communications outside normal working hours and during PTO.

question: Is a small gift to an employee of a state-run hospital abroad fine if it's cheap?
reference_answer: No. There is no minimum amount under the FCPA, and employees of government-owned or controlled companies such as hospitals count as government officials.

question: Is there an AI tool that summarises what I missed after coming back from leave?
reference_answer: Yes, GitLab's Back in the Loop Glean agent scans activity while you were out and generates a prioritized summary.

question: Can multi-source peer reviews stand in for ongoing feedback from my manager?
reference_answer: No. 360 feedback should not replace the regular, ongoing feedback team members receive throughout the year.

question: What is the capital of Australia?
How do I bake sourdough bread?
What is the exact salary of the CEO?
How many vacation days does GitLab give in Japan?
What is the office dress code at the Berlin headquarters?
Which stock price target did the board set for next year?
What is the password for the production database?
What's the shortest password I'm allowed to set on systems where password length can be configured?
reference_answer: The minimum password length must be set to 12 characters.

question: After how many wrong sign-in attempts should an account get temporarily locked?
reference_answer: After 10 failed login attempts (or the lowest value the system supports if it cannot do 10 or fewer).

question: If an app has only a password and no second factor, how often must that password be changed at most?
reference_answer: Within a maximum of 90 calendar days.

question: How quickly does a vulnerability scored CVSS 9.0-10.0 have to be mitigated?
reference_answer: Within 24 hours, with a 30 day remediation SLA.

question: What is the deadline for fixing a medium-severity vulnerability with a CVSS of 4.0-6.9?
reference_answer: A 90 day SLA to remediate (severity 3 / priority 3).

question: When does the issue for a bug bounty report become public after the fix ships?
reference_answer: The corresponding GitLab issue is made public 90 days after the patch is released.

question: How long do reviewers have to finish an audit-evidence access review once it is launched in Lumos?
reference_answer: 10 business days from the launch of the review in Lumos.

question: Can I generate new personal access tokens in the production environment?
reference_answer: No. PATs are highly discouraged in production and disallowed or disabled wherever possible; existing tokens remain but no additional ones may be issued.

question: Does a contractor with no access to internal systems need to take the yearly security awareness course?
reference_answer: No. Contractors without access to internal systems or sensitive data are not required to complete the annual training, but must complete training during onboarding.

question: Which UTC hours does the EMEA incident responder cover during the winter months?
reference_answer: From November to April the EMEA SIRT shift is 07:00 to 15:00 UTC.

question: How long are results of production backup tests kept?
reference_answer: Production backup tests must be retained for 1 year.

question: What page-load target should the largest element on a page hit?
reference_answer: Largest Contentful Paint should occur within 2.5 seconds of when the page starts loading.

question: A test fails in a pipeline that runs against a live environment. How soon should someone look at it?
reference_answer: Treat it as priority 1 / severity 1 and investigate ideally within 2 hours of the report.

question: How long should I hunt for a flaky test's root cause alone before getting help?
reference_answer: At most about 20-30 minutes of active investigation, excluding reporting, reading logs and test setup.

question: How long should I spend scoping out a bug issue for the replication team before writing the implementation details?
reference_answer: A timebox of about 2-3 hours for bugs, since they need to be reproduced first (about 1 hour for features and maintenance issues).

question: How much of each person's capacity do the analytics Optimize teams leave unplanned for research?
reference_answer: A buffer of 15% per team member is reserved for research and scoping.

question: How big a slowdown against the baseline still counts as no significant regression in self-service performance tests?
reference_answer: Less than a 5% difference versus the baseline.

question: Which team is responsible for the free-trial sign-up entry point in the billing portal?
reference_answer: Growth owns the trial entry endpoint and basic controller in CustomersDot; once the request crosses into provisioning, entitlement or billing it belongs to Fulfillment/Monetization.

question: Can I post the capacity forecast charts for GitLab.com publicly?
reference_answer: No. Tamland's output, including forecast plots and SLO violation information, is ORANGE data and must remain confidential.

question: How long does it take to load the test data when setting up a performance regression environment?
reference_answer: Loading data can take 1-2 hours, so it is recommended to run it in a screen session.

question: Who gets paged if nobody acknowledges a support on-call alert for ten minutes?
reference_answer: The Support Manager on-call is alerted; after a further 5 minutes with no acknowledgement the Senior Support Managers are alerted.

question: How often should I plan to pause during a long emergency customer call?
reference_answer: Tell the customer you plan to take a break about every 90 minutes.

question: I'm locked out of GitLab.com without my authenticator. Can I just open a ticket myself?
reference_answer: No. Support no longer accepts 2FA removal tickets filed directly by the locked-out user; a top-level group owner must submit the ticket on their behalf.

question: How many CI minutes does a trial plan come with by default?
reference_answer: All GitLab trial plans default to 400 compute minutes.

question: What first-response target does Support aim for on tickets?
reference_answer: A 95% SLA achievement KPI, so some breaching is expected.

question: What share of public ticket replies should an engineer be making on tickets assigned to themselves?
reference_answer: Around 50-60% of public replies on tickets assigned to themselves.

question: How much of a help-center article's opening text is used for search engine indexing?
reference_answer: The first 140 characters of the article's opening section are believed to be indexed for SEO.

question: When should a support engineer pick different vacation dates because the team would be too thin?
reference_answer: When the regional capacity calendar shows the regional team would be short by 20% or more of its people on any of the days.

question: How quickly does accounts payable need to process an expense report that needs their review?
reference_answer: Within 7 working days from the date submitted.

question: How long is the programme where you follow the chief financial officer around?
reference_answer: The CFO Shadow Program is an immersive 1 or 2 week assignment.

question: What do shadows have to say in Zoom chat during CFO meetings as the end approaches?
reference_answer: They give a 5-minute and a 1-minute notification, for example 'Time check, 5 minutes'.

question: After how long should we start thinking about converting an agency worker to a regular employee?
reference_answer: Around 12-24 months is the typical maximum before conversion consideration; some agencies cap at 12 months to avoid co-employment risks.

question: Can a manager directly terminate the contract of a temp worker supplied by an agency?
reference_answer: No. Managers must not hire or fire the worker directly; it must go through the agency.

question: How long does it take a vendor to sign up on the supplier portal?
reference_answer: The registration process takes less than 5 minutes after receiving the emailed invitation.

question: I lost a receipt for a purchase-card transaction. What do I attach instead?
reference_answer: A Missing Receipt Affidavit, attached to the expense as a PDF.

question: How long should a candidate expect to wait for a response after their friend's recommendation is submitted?
reference_answer: Per the SLA, allow 5 business days for the submission to be reviewed.

question: How far ahead of the coding interview do I get the merge request I'm supposed to review?
reference_answer: At least 72 hours before the scheduled call.

question: How long is the handover period when someone moves out of Sales Development to another role?
reference_answer: 45 days from the verbal offer (the standard for other moves is 4-6 weeks).

question: How quickly will support engineering applicants get feedback on their written assessment?
reference_answer: It takes 1-3 days to grade the assessment and reach out with feedback.

question: What is the usual notice before an internal job change takes effect?
reference_answer: Between 4-6 weeks for an official transition date, so the backfilling team has lead time.

question: How long does a learning stint on another team usually last?
reference_answer: Typically 6 weeks to 3 months, depending on the goals of the internship.

question: How long must I have been at the company before I can be someone's onboarding buddy?
reference_answer: Longer than 3 months.

question: What do I need to do on my first day if my work laptop runs Linux?
reference_answer: Enroll the device in Fleet as part of the Day 1 security tasks; Fleet then installs and enforces the required security tooling, including EDR.

question: What's the most I can get reimbursed for professional development in a calendar year?
reference_answer: Up to $10,000 per calendar year from the Growth and Development Fund.

question: Who has to sign off on a learning request costing $800?
reference_answer: Manager approval alone covers $0-$1,000; $1,000.01-$10,000 needs manager plus VP approval.

question: Where do I file a request for the learning fund and how early?
reference_answer: Submit it through Compass, at least 30 days before the experience begins when possible.

question: How long do I keep access to the online technical library before my seat is reassigned?
reference_answer: Access to the O'Reilly Learning library is removed after 3 months so the seat can be reallocated; you can re-request it.

question: By when do all the access removal tasks have to be finished for someone who has left?
reference_answer: Deprovisioning is urgent and all tasks are expected to be completed within 5 working days.

question: When should I book my embassy appointment if I'm moving abroad for work?
reference_answer: About 6 months beforehand, and start gathering the paperwork; the embassy interview is about 3 months beforehand.

question: How long after leaving the company can I still buy my vested shares?
reference_answer: 90 days after termination to exercise vested options; unvested RSUs and options are forfeited on the exit date.

question: What weekly hours do I need to join the employee share purchase scheme?
reference_answer: Team members must work more than 20 hours per week.

question: How much extra pay do I get for temporarily covering a vacant role?
reference_answer: On a base salary plan, an additional 10% of salary for the duration of the interim role; coverage must be longer than 30 days to be considered.

question: How much will the company add to my retirement savings in Canada?
reference_answer: Employer matching up to 3% of base salary, with a maximum of $2,500 CAD annually, via the Group RRSP.

question: How much dental cover do UK team members get each year?
reference_answer: Dental coverage is £400 per year, with 80% reimbursement.

question: What is the minimum paid holiday for Dutch employees?
reference_answer: At least 20 vacation days per year, accruing at 1.67 days per month; they run concurrently with GitLab PTO.

question: What raise budget was set for the annual pay review in FY27?
reference_answer: 3.5% of Total Target Cash for all countries except India, which is funded at 7%.

question: Is pre-existing condition health cover in New Zealand immediate?
reference_answer: Only if you enroll within 90 days of your start date.

question: How long does each mandatory ethics and compliance course take?
reference_answer: Each course should take around 30 minutes or less.

question: Who is covered by the policy on deals with insiders when they own more than 5% of the voting stock?
reference_answer: The related party transactions policy applies to executive officers, board members and significant stockholders owning more than 5% of any class of voting securities.

question: I accidentally revealed unreleased financial information. Who do I tell?
reference_answer: Contact the Chief Legal Officer and the Legal and Compliance team immediately via the #safe Slack channel.

question: Does a manager need a formal complaint before acting on suspected misconduct?
reference_answer: No. Managers must address misconduct as soon as they become aware, whether or not a written or formal complaint was made, and handle it seriously, confidentially and fairly.

question: What service-time and hours conditions make me eligible for unpaid family medical leave in the US?
reference_answer: 12 months of continuous service and 1250 hours worked in the year immediately before the leave begins.

question: How many weeks of unpaid job-protected leave does the US family medical law give for my own serious illness?
reference_answer: Up to 12 weeks of unpaid leave (up to 26 workweeks to care for an injured service member).

question: When do I have to report a health-related absence to the leave administrator?
reference_answer: If away more than 5 days, continuously or not, for the same condition, it must be reported to Tilt.

question: How soon after noticing harassment must a US employee report it to management or HR?
reference_answer: Within 48 hours of the incident.

question: In India, when can a disability-related absence be handled under the sick time policy?
reference_answer: When the leave request for a disability-related reason exceeds six consecutive days, it may be administered as a leave of absence under the Sick Time policy.
